primaryTextExcerpts.text: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,
He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”
of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
